WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(i.income_id) AS income_count
    FROM income AS i
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m.link_to_major
), department_shares AS (
    SELECT dc.major_id, dc.income_count,
           1.0 * dc.income_count / SUM(dc.income_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts AS dc
), above_average AS (
    SELECT income_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM department_shares
)
SELECT SUM(income_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(average_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: Only income records linked to a member with a linked major and a non-NULL department are counted; each department’s share is its income count divided by the total counts across those departments. The average share is the unweighted average across departments represented in those counts.
